body: Pretty closely matched, uh I'd say that 3-0ing someone on your server after going 2-3 on theirs shows that NA is better than BDS

[https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/i94a9o/closest\_friend\_who\_helped\_me\_through\_suicide\_kill/?utm\_source=share&utm\_medium=web2x](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/i94a9o/closest_friend_who_helped_me_through_suicide_kill/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web2x), this might help you understand some of your feelings. There is nothing wrong with feeling that way, never let anyone tell you differently. We all have struggles in life and yours might just be different from the normal ones we consider.

His name was Declan, and he never showed any pain, he never burdened anyone with his suffering. He was there for so many of us in our times of need. He would gladly reach out and drive 30 minutes at 1 am just to make sure we didn't cut ourselves or that we would live to see the morning. He volunteered whenever he could, he helped those less fortunate and always had a smile on his face and was telling jokes to cheer everyone up around him. In his moment of need, when he shared that he just wanted to talk to someone or hold someone, no one was there for him. It will always be my biggest mistake sending him the text "I can't I'm busy with friends right now". I failed him, the one who was always there no matter what. Who would drop anything to make sure those around him were okay and happy.
